title: Making this remake mod for Wing Commander 3 with VR en CO-OP
author: AvonMexicola
selftext:
Been working on this for a few months now, the game game can be played front to back now in VR and CO-OP. Still working on updating the Kilrathi assets. 

I decompiled the game using Claude Code. Then I noticed the in-game unit system made NO sense so I had a comparison system build by Astra that placed a ship on a fixed distance in world units and then measured it's width in pixels. Then I made 1 ship (the VIctory) the size standard at 720m

For speeds I measured how long it took a fighter to pass the hero asset and from there rebuild the world unit system. Check the speedlab I made here [https://www.staragent.site/speed-lab/](https://www.staragent.site/speed-lab/) . Now I am working together with some of the biggest wing commander fans in order to get some high quality models out that fit the original designs well.
